hero.headline: Our Sociocratic Circles
hero.intro: Circles are how the village thinks: each one tends its own domain the way a tree tends its own ground, and double links weave them into one canopy.
hero.firstTip: A domain is the ground a circle decides on without asking anyone above it. Real authority lives inside it.
hero.secondTip: Two people belong to both a circle and the circle above it, one chosen by each. News travels both ways, so no circle drifts alone.

today.heading: The Circles Today
today.intro: How the team actually organizes right now, while the village is being built.

future.heading: As the Village Matures
future.intro: As residents arrive, today's team circles grow into resident-led councils like these: domain-specific circles connected through elected representatives.

card.label: How it works:
card.linked: Each circle has autonomy within its domain and budget, uses consent-based decision-making, and is double-linked to the {coordinator} so information flows both ways.
card.flat: Each circle has autonomy within its domain and budget and uses consent-based decision-making.

together.heading: How Circles Work Together
together.first: Each circle has **a domain, a budget, and the authority** to make decisions within that domain.
together.acrossLinked: When decisions affect multiple circles, the **{coordinator}**, the four leads and circle representatives, coordinates.
together.acrossFlat: When decisions affect multiple circles, the circles involved decide together.
together.after: The Finance & Business Circle provides budget stewardship, oversight, and alignment across all circles.
together.second: Circles use **consent-based decision-making**: a proposal moves forward unless someone has a reasoned objection that it would cause harm or prevent the circle from achieving its aim. This creates space for wisdom and prevents tyranny of the majority.
together.thirdLinked: Every circle is **double-linked** to the {coordinator} by two people, so information flows both ways. Regular reporting, check-ins, and feedback keep the whole aligned and adaptable.
together.thirdFlat: Regular reporting, check-ins, and feedback between circles keep the whole aligned and adaptable.
